CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 22
   C. 16
   D. 32

7. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 6

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

9. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 32

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 40
   C. 75
   D. 30

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

12. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 7

13. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 8
   C. 4
   D. 7

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

15. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

16. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

18. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 37

19. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 15

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

22. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 2

23. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
